'''Vincent Richard Gray''' (24 March 1922 – 14 June 2018) was a [[New Zealand]] [[chemist]], and a founder of the [[climate change denial]] organization [[New Zealand Climate Science Coalition]].

==Career==
Born in [[London]] on 24 March 1922,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://search.ancestry.com.au/cgi-bin/sse.dll?ti=5544&indiv=try&db=nznaturalisations&h=65702 |title=New Zealand, naturalisations, 1843–1981 |publisher=Ancestry.com Operations |access-date=16 January 2016 |url-access=subscription }}</ref> Gray was awarded a PhD in physical chemistry by the [[University of Cambridge]] after studies on [[Incendiary device|incendiary bomb]] fluids made from aluminium soaps. He moved to New Zealand in 1970 to become the first Director of the Building Research Association (BRANZ) and later, Chief Chemist of the Coal Research Association.<ref name=NZHerald>{{cite news |url=http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=10409062 |title=It's hype, hysteria and hot air says climate change nay-sayers |newspaper=New Zealand Herald |first=Chris |last=Barton |date=4 November 2006 |access-date=15 August 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110604182801/http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=10409062 |archive-date=4 June 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |url=http://cat.inist.fr/?aModele=afficheN&cpsidt=8335060 |last=Gray |first=V.R. |year=1986 |title=The chemical properties and composition of Mokau Coal |journal=New Zealand Journal of Geology and Geophysics |volume= 29 |issue=4 |pages= 447–461 |doi=10.1080/00288306.1986.10422166|bibcode=1986NZJGG..29..447G |doi-access=free |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
He also published many articles and reports, seven in peer-reviewed journals.

==Views on climate change==
After retirement, he had four and a half years in China and when he returned became a critic of the claim that climate was harmed by human [[Greenhouse gas emissions|emissions of greenhouse gases]].

He commented on every publication of the [[Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change]], with 1,898 comments on the [[IPCC Fourth Assessment Report|2007 Report]]. He published critical studies on all of the reports, including a 2002 book ''The Greenhouse Delusion: A Critique of 'Climate Change 2001'''. He published his autobiography ''Confessions of a Climate Sceptic'' in 2010 <ref>{{cite book| url=https://www.blurb.com/bookstore/detail/1654887| title=Confessions of a Climate Sceptic| first=Vincent| last=Gray |date=2010}}</ref>
He was dismissive of anthropogenic [[global warming]].<ref>"I know of many New Zealand scientists who are AGW sceptics. ... Vincent Gray, retired chemist living in Wellington (who wrote a book “The Greenhouse Delusion”, published in the UK) . . ."[http://ff.org/centers/csspp/library/co2weekly/20060404_01/20060404_05.html The Anthropogenic Global Warming Doctrine] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100610062232/http://ff.org/centers/csspp/library/co2weekly/20060404_01/20060404_05.html |date=10 June 2010 }} Dr Gerrit J. van der Lingen, Newsletter of the Geological Society of New Zealand, N0 138, November 2005: 60–64.</ref>

Gray called for the [[Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change|IPCC]] to be abolished, claiming it was “fundamentally corrupt” and that significant parts of the work of the IPCC, the data collection and scientific methods employed, were unsound.<ref name="natpost">{{cite news |url=http://www.financialpost.com/story.html?id=55387187-4d06-446f-9f4f-c2397d155a32 |title=IPCC too blinkered and corrupt to save |newspaper=National Post |last=Solomon |first=Lawrence |date=26 October 2007  |access-date=15 August 2010 }}</ref>

Gray was featured on the [[Australian Broadcasting Corporation]] program [[Counterpoint (Radio National)|Counterpoint]] in a debate entitled "Nine Lies about Global Warming",<ref>{{cite web
|author1=Michael Duffy |author2=Michael Manton |author3=Ray Evans |author4=Vincent Gray |title=Nine Lies about Global Warming
|url= https://www.abc.net.au/rn/counterpoint/stories/2006/1627562.htm
|series= Counterpoint |publisher=ABC Radio National
|date=8 May 2006 |access-date= 27 August 2010 }}</ref> and was interviewed in a featured story in ''[[The New Zealand Herald]]'' as a "prominent" global warming nay-sayer.<ref name="NZHerald"/>

In his book ''The Greenhouse Delusion: A Critique of "Climate Change 2001"'',<ref>{{cite book| url=http://www.multi-science.co.uk/greendelu.htm| title=The Greenhouse Delusion| first=Vincent| last=Gray| isbn=0-906522-14-5| date=August 2002| publisher=Multi-Science| archive-date=25 March 2019| access-date=27 December 2007| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190325010555/http://www.multi-science.co.uk/greendelu.htm| url-status=dead}}</ref> Gray argued "that the quality and reliability of the IPCC's measurements are poor, the system of determining how much weight should be attributed to different influences on the earth's temperature is faulty, and the validity of evidence derived from computer modeling is questionable."

Gray died in [[Petone]] on 14 June 2018, aged 96.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Manson |first1=Bess |title=Mary and Vincent Gray - couple die 15 days apart |url=https://www.stuff.co.nz/life-style/105746754/mary-and-vincent-gray--couple-die-15-days-apart |access-date=2 December 2019 |work=stuff |date=28 July 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url=http://notices.nzherald.co.nz/obituaries/nzherald-nz/obituary.aspx?n=vincent-richard-gray&pid=189300065 | title=Vincent Richard Gray death notice | date=16 June 2018 | work=New Zealand Herald | access-date=16 June 2018}}</ref>
